title: BlackRoad OS Philosophy Quiz
description: Test your understanding of BlackRoad OS core principles

questions.prompt: What are the four core principles of BlackRoad OS?
hints: Think about what makes BlackRoad OS unique
Review the philosophy lesson section on Core Principles

questions.prompt: What is a 'Pack' in BlackRoad OS?

options.text: A self-contained domain/vertical module (e.g., Education, Finance)

hints: Think about how BlackRoad OS organizes different domains

questions.prompt: In BlackRoad OS, agents are treated as first-class citizens with clear boundaries.
What does the 'structured' principle mean in BlackRoad OS?

options.text: All code must follow strict formatting rules
Work is defined as flows, content follows schemas, verticals are Packs

hints: Think about flows, schemas, and Packs

questions.prompt: Explain in one sentence why transparency and auditability matter in BlackRoad OS.
questions.correctAnswer: Transparency and auditability ensure all work flows are visible, versioned, and traceable, which is critical for compliance, accountability, and understanding how the system operates.
hints: Consider why someone would need to see what happened
